article: TileLang CUDA Z3：用一条 A+B 流水理解调度与自动调优

visual_gate.evidence: All pages were independently inspected. No clipping, overflow, garbled CJK/KaTeX, heading orphans, excessive blank space, unreadable code, or catalog-only pages was found. Cross-page tables repeat headers and prose remains coherent.

automated_pdf_qa.resolution: The independent 25-page visual pass found no actual punctuation, overflow, centering, or readability defect. Warnings are retained rather than hidden.

html_preflight_note: The generic HTML validator flags KaTeX @font-face descriptors for lacking generic fallbacks. CSS @font-face descriptors require a single family name, and all KaTeX fonts are embedded; no fallback was added. Actual PDF font rendering and embedding passed.

tutorial_structure.review: One running A+B example teaches latency, II, dependencies, modulo scheduling, versions, Task/Stage, three correctness cases, and guided search without an 84-row catalog in the main text.
